source.name: Lowe's Corporate – 'Inter Miami CF and Lowe's Renew Partnership as Lowe's Becomes a Main Partner, Official Jersey Sleeve Partner, Founding Partner of Miami Freedom Park'
source.quote: the Official and Exclusive Home Improvement Partner of Inter Miami CF will now serve as the Official Jersey Sleeve Partner across Inter Miami CF's First Team, MLS Next Pro team, and Academy teams

note: Multiyear deal, from 2026 (collaboration began April 2024). Sports Business Journal (via Sportcal) called it the richest and longest sleeve sponsorship in MLS history; no exact value published.
